CustomField.description: The org-wide logo a Banner shows when a Form Template has no logo of its own, stored as the public asset's name (an https:// link is also accepted). Picked with Select Image on the Form Builder's Global Styles tab and read by the Logo formula field on Form Template. Not a style token.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Set this on the Form Builder's Global Styles tab: click Select Image and pick the logo from your org's public assets.
CustomField.label: Default Logo
